scale_policy.rule: max = clamp(ceil(4 x attacker attack damage / 100) x 100, 400, 1000); coarse step 50; figures every 100

scale.basis: 4 x attack damage 93.27, rounded up to 100, clamped [400, 1000]

assumptions: Frozen state: one specified hit, both champions at the stated levels, nothing else happening.
No runes, no stat shards, no form or transformation on either side.
Items contribute base stats only; no item passive or active is modelled.
Target armor is the stated total; no armor reduction (shred) is in effect.
After armor: percent armor penetration, then flat penetration and lethality, then the armor formula.
